title: kb/_self/map.csv maps the otel adapter's modules and kbmon's mon_ modules to the docs that name them
goal: map.csv maps otel/*.py to kb/_self/monitoring.md and kb/_self/code.md, and _tools/mon_*.py to kb/_self/code.md, so a plan that adds such a module gets those docs in its touches

run:
import csv,fnmatch,sys
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/map.csv',encoding='utf-8')))
need=[('kb/_self/code.md','_tools/mon_events.py'),('kb/_self/monitoring.md','otel/otel_logs.py'),('kb/_self/code.md','otel/otel_spans.py')]
miss=[n for n in need if not any(r['doc']==n[0] and fnmatch.fnmatch(n[1],r['pattern']) for r in rows)]
print(miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

notes: SP-qvlnptiw: ST-exnzb4pf and ST-jx3c5vxm stopped on kb/_self/code.md outside their touches (new mon_ modules); otel_prom.py, otel_logs.py and otel_spans.py have no map row.
